prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Yama agent artwork for a dark incident-intelligence interface.
Primary request: create one exceptionally art-directed sculptural ribbon companion, abstract and tactile, like a small expressive figure made from a single thick folded silk-paper ribbon. The ribbon forms an open curved listening fold at the top and two gently crossing folds at its base. No literal ear, no facial features. It should feel considerate, curious, quietly alive, contemporary art rather than a corporate mascot.
Composition: isolated complete figure centered, tall 4:5 composition, generous empty margins, no crop. Transparent background.
Style: editorial sculpture rendered with deliberate large visible ordered dither pixels and print grain, limited colors. Form must remain clear and satisfyingly sculptural. Fine paper fibers, sharp broad folds, no plastic gloss.
Palette: cool chalk, pale coral, deep ink-plum shadows, small pale blue highlights. Darkest shadows suit a plum interface. No gradients added behind the figure.
Constraints: only this one folded ribbon figure; no text, no logo, no UI, no stand, no orb, no sphere, no cute cartoon eyes, no bird, no hands, no neon glow. Real transparent background. High craft.
